captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0, so the reel's own captions carry the words; the grid is background behind the speaker
in_a_reel: set F_IN to 8 or later and F_OUT at least 45 frames after it and 2 frames before the slot ends, so the slot starts and ends on the plain room
COUNTS stays {} unless the buyer gives real view counts: never estimate or round up a number
steps: do ask the buyer for a folder of their own reel cover images (their saved covers, or covers exported from their profile) and copy them into <slot>/covers/ (fx_new.py --buyer-files <folder> does the copy). No covers from the buyer = no Couch Wall: leave it out and say so
run onsets.py      # copy the user's reel covers into ./covers  (create the folder; 4 or more images); 1. word onsets as frames -> F_IN, F_OUT, CAPS in build.py
run prep.py      # 2. covers, camera track, wall matte, fg.webm (about 3 min). LOOK at work/wall.jpg. If the cyan area is wrong, edit WALL / IN_FRONT / BEHIND / WALL_TOL, then
run prep.py wall      # re-measure only (20 s); repeat until right, then run. prep.py once more WITHOUT "wall" so fg.webm is baked from the final matte
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # 3. page with the safe guide
run build.py CAPTIONS=0      # 4. clean page (no guide), then render

buyer_folder.name: covers
buyer_folder.what: the buyer's own reel cover images (jpg, png or webp; 9 or more looks best)
